decision_notes: National legislature/chamber identity cross-checked against the institution, Wikidata and the primary IPU profile where accessible. This is separate from media and rights evidence. Primary evidence: https://data.ipu.org/parliament/TL/TL-LC01/

Official homepage and Canal Parlamento designate dated plenary recordings, including 15 July and 15 June 2026. Both play beyond opening graphics. The legacy /parlamentotl/streams handle returns 404; use the official video index. Committee field visits are not committee-hearing validation.

Source conditions: The reviewed official viewing pages designate public access, but no independent audiovisual reuse grant was established. Institutional ownership and working platform playback are not permission to extract, embed or redistribute media.
Catalogue, flags, localized country/jurisdiction search, map and planned schedule-source links reconciled. Link-out only; no HLS or implemented EPG promotion.
